rationale: Luke is a founding engineer at Infinity AI Institute building a script-to-movie foundation model, while Symphony Creative Studio is ByteDance's AI-powered video generation and ad creative suite—both operating at the intersection of generative video and creative tooling. intro_message: Luke Bechtel, meet Symphony Creative Studio — you're both shipping in generative video, and Luke's founding engineer experience at a YC-backed script-to-movie company could offer useful perspective on the creative AI tooling you're building at TikTok.
